name: env-map-lab
description: Where Everything Runs: a map of where a team's software runs (a local machine, Kubernetes namespaces, SaaS services) as a diagram and a table, with a computed what-if. Mock shows a made-up sample snapshot; Real shows a snapshot file produced by the owner-run read-only collector.

scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
